title: Digital Marketing and Sales
description:
Digital Marketing & Business Development Executive

Salary: £30,000 £35,000 Location: St Ives Cambridgeshire Area Hours: Monday Friday, 9am 5pm Contract: Full-time, permanent

Own transport required due to location

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, commercially minded Digital Marketing & Business Development Executive to take ownership of our digital marketing, strengthen our brand and support business growth.

This is a newly created, varied role combining digital marketing, content creation, lead generation and customer engagement. You will work closely with senior management and the Commercial team to increase brand awareness, attract new customers and re-engage existing clients.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and develop the company website and LinkedIn presence.
- Create engaging digital content, promotional materials and marketing campaigns.
- Improve brand visibility and generate new business leads.
- Engage prospective customers, qualify opportunities and direct leads to the relevant teams.
- Re-engage existing customers and support relationship development.
- Research markets and identify new commercial opportunities.
- Work alongside the Business Development and Commercial teams to support growth.
- Represent the business at occasional customer visits and UK trade shows.

About You
- Strong digital marketing skills, particularly LinkedIn, website management and content creation.
- Creative, proactive and confident taking ownership of a new role.
- Commercially minded, with an interest in sales, lead generation and business development.
- Excellent communication and organisational skills.
- Able to work independently and collaborate effectively with colleagues.

Experience in engineering, electronics, instrumentation or manufacturing would be advantageous, but candidates from other industries with strong digital marketing skills are encouraged to apply.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to shape a developing marketing function, make a tangible impact on business growth and build your commercial and business development experience.

The role is site-based, working Monday to Friday, 9am 5pm, with occasional UK travel for customer visits and trade shows.

If you have the skills and experience listed above please send your CV to (url removed) or call (phone number removed).

title: Digital Marketing Officer
description:
An exciting full-time opportunity has opened up at CPSL Mind.

CPSL Mind is a vibrant, values-led charity that supports local people in their recovery from mental health issues, promotes wellbeing and campaigns against stigma and discrimination.

Digital Marketing Officer
Salary: £28,773.00 per annum
Salary Scale Point: 18 (April 2025)
Contract: Permanent
Work Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours per week)
Based: Cambridge or Peterborough office with hybrid working option + travel across all of the CPSL Mind area.

About CPSL Mind

Cambridgeshire, Peterborough and South Lincolnshire (CPSL) Mind is a progressive and expanding mental health charity. Our vision is a society in which everyone has positive mental health and feels part of a connected community.

Our work ranges from prevention and early intervention to award-winning crisis support. We also seek to influence positive change through our training services and ground-breaking campaigns activity.

About You and the Role

Our Digital Marketing Officer will support in the development of high-quality digital communications and content that promotes CPSL Mind's services, campaigns and impact. They will help to develop and deliver engaging multimedia content, using insight and performance data to improve digital engagement, to meet the organisation's communications objectives and strengthen brand presence across digital channels.

In particular, the Digital Marketing Officer will:
- Support the development of CPSL Mind's digital engagement approach.
- Work collaboratively with the website agency and communications team to implement improvements based on performance data.
- Support in the coordination of website projects to support efficiency and output.

To apply you should have demonstrable experience of creating and adapting video and photography content for a variety of platforms and audiences, the ability to respond to a brief and develop engaging, inclusive, and impactful creative design assets, within tight timescale, together with a relevant digital marketing qualification or work/volunteering experience.

Closing Date: Thursday, 19th November 2026
Interview Date: to be confirmed

Interested?

If you would like to find out more, please click the apply button. You will be directed to our website to complete your application for this position.

CPSL Mind is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

We actively promote equality of opportunity for all with the right mix of talent, skills and potential and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates, including those with criminal records. Having a criminal record will not necessarily bar you from working with us. This will depend on the nature of the position and the circumstances and background of your offences.

CPSL Mind is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and adults at risk. We expect all employees and volunteers to share this commitment and work in accordance with our safeguarding policies and procedures.

No agencies please.

title: Interim Marketing Campaigns Executive
description:
Marketing Campaigns & Events Executive Peterborough 28,000 - 35,000 DOE 6-Month Temporary Contract

Potential to become permanent Hybrid Working Free Parking

Are you a creative and commercially minded marketing professional looking for an opportunity to make a genuine difference? Do you enjoy delivering engaging campaigns, coordinating events and creating content that drives results?
We are working with a fantastic organisation based in Peterborough that is dedicated to supporting and giving back to the animal and veterinary community. This is an exciting opportunity to join their marketing team on an initial 6-month temporary contract, with the potential for the role to become permanent for the right person.If you're passionate about marketing and love the idea of working for an organisation that makes a positive impact, this could be the perfect next step in your career.

Your new role

As Marketing Campaigns & Events Executive, you'll play a key role in planning, delivering and optimising integrated marketing campaigns across a variety of channels. You'll work closely with internal stakeholders to support audience growth, lead generation, brand awareness and commercial objectives.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Planning and delivering integrated marketing campaigns across digital, email, social media, content and print channels.
- Creating engaging marketing content and promotional materials.
- Supporting lead generation campaigns and customer acquisition activities.
- Managing social media activity, including paid and organic campaigns.
- Coordinating webinars, podcasts, thought leadership initiatives and digital events.
- Managing attendance at industry exhibitions and events, including logistics, promotional materials and supplier liaison.
- Producing campaign performance reports and analysing key marketing data and metrics.
- Working collaboratively with internal teams to support business growth and commercial objectives.
- Creating and editing digital content, including graphics, video and social media assets.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a marketing, campaign management or digital marketing position.
- Experience delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns.
- Strong content creation skills with experience using tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
- Knowledge of social media marketing, email campaigns and CRM platforms.
- Experience analysing campaign performance and producing reports.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive, creative and results-driven approach.

Experience coordinating events, webinars, exhibitions or conferences would be highly advantageous.

What you'll get in return
- Salary of 28,000 - 35,000 depending on experience.
- Initial 6-month temporary contract with the possibility of a permanent opportunity.
- Hybrid working, with a minimum of 1 day per week in the office (ideally 2-3 days).
- Full-time hours: Monday-Thursday 9:00am-5:30pm and Friday 9:00am-5:00pm.
- Free on-site parking.
- Opportunity to work for a highly respected organisation that genuinely gives back and makes a positive impact.
- Varied and rewarding role with exposure to campaigns, events, digital marketing and content creation.
- Friendly and supportive team environment.

What you need to do now

title: PR manager
description:
PR manager

Location: Contracted to our Peterborough office with the flexibility for hybrid working

Salary: £36,000 - £40,000 depending on experience

Hours: Full time, 37.5 hours per week

Contract: Permanent

Benefits: We want all our employees to feel valued and engaged and are committed to offering a positive working culture along with a good work-life balance. As well as ensuring we pay our employees fairly, we offer the following benefits: Flexible working, Generous annual leave, Private Medical Insurance, including dental and optical, Pension Scheme, Sick Pay, Death in Service, Employee Assistance Programme, Bike Loan Scheme, Cycle 2 Work Scheme, Eyecare, Discount Portal.

Be a part of an energetic and vibrant team who are driven by the desire to improve the lives of people living with kidney disease. Our vision is the day when everyone lives free from kidney disease.

Kidney disease affects one in ten people in the UK, yet it still doesn't get the attention it deserves. At Kidney Research UK we are determined to change that. We're looking for an experienced PR manager to help us significantly grow our media reach and make kidney disease impossible to ignore.

The Role
- Lead our press office and storytelling function, shaping and delivering coverage that raises the profile of the charity
- Show the reality, urgency and impact of kidney disease on patients and their families
- Act as the first point of contact in the press office, spotting news stories and building lasting relationships with journalists
- Oversee our people and fundraising communications function
- Ensure patient and supporter stories are handled with care and the right consent, with safeguarding and data processes in place
- Develop integrated plans with our fundraising teams, telling inspiring stories that encourage people to get involved
- Work closely with fundraising, policy, research and marketing and communications colleagues to ensure PR plays a central role in our strategic priorities and campaigns

What We're Looking For
- A strong track record in press or media relations
- Excellent writing skills
- The judgement to operate confidently and at pace
- Ability to spot a news story
- The credibility to build and maintain relationships with journalists
- Experience handling sensitive stories, consent, safeguarding and data processes with care
- Ability to collaborate across teams and build buy-in for PR within strategic priorities
- Passion for making a difference to people living with kidney disease

About Kidney Research UK:

Kidney Research UK is the leading charity in the UK focused on funding research into the prevention, treatment and management of kidney disease. Our vision is the day when everyone lives free from kidney disease and for more than 60 years the research, we fund has been making an impact. But kidney disease is increasing as are the factors contributing to it, such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease and obesity, making our work more essential than ever.

At Kidney Research UK we work with clinicians and scientists across the UK, funding and facilitating research into all areas of kidney disease. We collaborate with partners across the public, private and third sectors to prevent kidney disease and drive innovation to transform treatments.

Over the last ten years we have invested more than £71 million into research. We lobby governments and decision makers to change policy and practice to ensure that the estimated 7.2 million people living with all stages of kidney disease in the UK have access to the most effective care and treatment, and to make kidney disease a priority.

Most importantly, we also work closely with patients, ensuring their voice is heard and is at the centre of everything we do, from deciding which research to invest in to how we plan our priorities and our work across the charity. Those patient contributions are vital, always helping us and our partners to understand what life is like with kidney disease, always ensuring we see the patient behind the treatment and always reminding us that behind every statistic and every number is a person - the patients and the carers who inspire our mission and push us forward to make a difference and change the future of kidney disease.

How to Apply

If you're ready to make kidney disease impossible to ignore, we'd love to hear from you. Please complete the online application form and submit together with your CV. Closing date: Sunday 22 November 2026.

Interviews will be held in our Peterborough office on Thursday 3 December 2026.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone and encourage applications from all sections of the community.

No agencies please.

You may have experience in the following: PR Manager, Press Officer, Media Relations Manager, Head of Press, Senior Press Officer, Public Relations Manager, Communications Manager, Media Manager, Case Study Manager, Storytelling, Charity Communications Manager, Charity PR, Charities, Third Sector, Not for Profit, NFP, etc.

title: Senior Communications Officer
company: East Cambridgeshire District Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a creative communicator ready to celebrate local government achievements? East Cambridgeshire District Council has an exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity!

Location: Ely, Cambridgeshire, CB7 4 EE

Salary: £34,811 to £39,481 per annum

Job Type: Full time, 12 months fixed term contract

Hours: Hybrid working, with attendance at council offices three days per week

Closing Date: Sunday 25 October 2026

About Us:

East Cambridgeshire District Council is a local government organisation serving residents across the region. We are committed to delivering high-quality, customer-focused services and have recently achieved silver accreditation from the Investors in the Environment scheme, ranking 43rd nationally on the council climate scorecard. We prioritise environmental sustainability and responsible operations while supporting our communities.

Senior Communications Officer - The Role:

You will work as part of a busy, collaborative communications team to deliver clear, consistent and engaging communications to residents, employees, councillors and stakeholders. Your primary focus will be promoting the council's achievements, demonstrating the positive impact of its services and showing how the council improves local people's lives. You will manage multiple projects, create compelling content and build positive relationships across council services and external partners.

Senior Communications Officer - Key Responsibilities:
- Produce clear, accurate and engaging content for websites, newsletters, social media, briefing notes and press releases
- Develop and deliver communications and engagement plans that promote the council's priorities, services and achievements
- Create case studies, success stories and community outcomes for use across media and digital channels
- Manage and monitor social media channels, creating engaging content and responding to enquiries
- Create and maintain website content that is accurate, accessible and user-focused
- Support internal communications activities to keep employees informed about council priorities and organisational change
- Build effective relationships with colleagues, partners and media to gather information and promote council achievements
- Monitor media coverage and social media activity, identifying opportunities and reputational risks
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness and report on performance metrics
- Participate in the 24/7 communications on-call rota and work outside normal hours when necessary

Senior Communications Officer - You:
- Excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Experienced in developing and delivering communications campaigns and engagement activities
- Skilled in creating engaging content across digital and traditional channels
- Confident in managing corporate social media platforms and online communities
- Passionate about storytelling and showcasing positive outcomes for residents and communities
- Collaborative team player equally confident working independently and using your own initiative

Benefits:
- The opportunity to help communicate and celebrate the council's achievements and contribution to local communities as local government transitions to new unitary authorities
- Potential to contribute to a major local government transformation programme
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
- Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Learning and development opportunities
- A supportive and experienced communications team

Closing date for completed applications: Sunday 25 October 2026

The selection process will be: Wednesday 4 and Thursday 5 November 2026

To submit your CV for this exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity, click Apply today!
